offers_products.reason: Makes welding and cutting equipment, consumables, gas regulators, valves and inspection instruments.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly from manufactured goods; service and support are incidental to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells industrial fabrication, gas control and inspection products to businesses; hobbyist welders are a minor channel.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are fabricators, manufacturers, distributors, medical gas and life sciences firms, and asset owners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Welding consumables, filler metals and gas control parts are repeatedly reordered, making up about half or more of sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Welding equipment and fabrication demand tied to industrial production and construction; customers can defer equipment purchases in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Largest part is welding consumables and mid-priced equipment, bought frequently; large cutting systems are a smaller share.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured welding equipment, consumables and gas control products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells welding products through distributors to many fabricators and small shops, alongside some large industrial accounts.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many manufacturing plants worldwide for welding equipment, consumables and gas control products; heavy manufacturing needs ongoing plant investment.

notes: Recurring-revenue judgment is uncertain: consumables are repeat purchases, but equipment is a large share.
